# UI/UX Design Specification (ui-ux-pro-max Standards)

## 1. Design System & Tokens (`ui-ux-pro-max`)

### 🎨 Color Palette & CSS Variables
| Token | Light Mode Value | Dark Mode Value | Usage |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--color-primary` | `#6366F1` (Indigo-500) | `#818CF8` (Indigo-400) | Main action buttons, active states, branding |
| `--color-secondary` | `#7C3AED` (Violet-600) | `#A78BFA` (Violet-400) | Agent skill badges, model selector chips |
| `--color-accent` | `#0EA5E9` (Sky-500) | `#38BDF8` (Sky-400) | Verifiable citation chips & source tags |
| `--color-background`| `#F8FAFC` (Slate-50) | `#0B0F19` (Slate-950) | Main app canvas background |
| `--color-surface` | `#FFFFFF` (White) | `#111827` (Slate-900) | Sidebar, chat cards, artifact viewer background |
| `--color-border` | `#E2E8F0` (Slate-200) | `#1E293B` (Slate-800) | Dividers, split-screen borders, card outlines |
| `--color-foreground`| `#0F172A` (Slate-900) | `#F8FAFC` (Slate-50) | High-contrast body typography |
| `--color-muted` | `#64748B` (Slate-500) | `#94A3B8` (Slate-400) | Timestamps, metadata, secondary captions |
| `--color-destructive`| `#EF4444` (Red-500) | `#F87171` (Red-400) | Disconnected state / error toasts |

### 🔤 Typography Hierarchy
- **Body & Headings:** `Inter`, `-apple-system`, `sans-serif` (Optimal for skimmable reading and conversational text).
- **Code & Citations:** `JetBrains Mono`, `Fira Code`, `monospace` (For code blocks, raw markdown tabs, and token counts).
- **Weights:** Regular (`400`), Medium (`500`), Semibold (`600`), Bold (`700`).

## 3. UI/UX Interaction States & Guidelines

### 3.1 Initial / Welcome State
- Clean, focused hero section with instant prompt starter chips:
  - ⚡ *"What are Brian Balfour's 4 growth loops?"*
  - 📊 *"Generate a B2B SaaS pricing framework (Ship 30 for 30 style)"*
  - 🛠️ *"Build an interactive launch readiness checklist (HTML widget)"*
  - 👥 *"Elena Verna's advice on Product-Led Sales"*

### 3.2 Streaming & Real-Time Feedback
- **Token streaming:** Smooth opacity-based text appearance.
- **RAG Retrieval Indicator:** Subtle animated pulsing badge (`Searching 200+ Lenny transcripts...`).
- **Citation Badges:** Expandable Sky-blue chips with episode title, guest name, and timestamp. Clicking opens an excerpt drawer.

### 3.3 Side-by-Side Sandboxed Artifact Viewer
- **Split-Screen Transition:** Smooth CSS grid transition when an artifact is returned (50% chat / 50% artifact).
- **Tabbed Switching:** Instant toggle between `Preview` (live rendered interactive widget) and `Code` (raw syntax-highlighted HTML/Markdown).
- **Utility Actions:** Top-right action bar with `Copy Code`, `Download .html/.md`, and `Close Panel`.
- **Security Sandboxing:** All HTML rendered via `<iframe sandbox="allow-scripts" srcDoc={content}>` with strict CSP (`connect-src 'none'`).

### 3.4 Resilience & Disconnected State
- If **Local Ollama** is selected but offline:
  - Non-blocking banner with a friendly recovery prompt:
    `"⚠️ Ollama daemon not detected on http://localhost:11434."`
  - Action button: `[Switch to Cloud Claude]` or `[Retry Connection]`.

---

## 4. `ui-ux-pro-max` Pre-Delivery Checklist Compliance

- [x] **No Emoji Icons:** Uses official SVG icons exclusively (`Lucide React`: `MessageSquare`, `Sparkles`, `Code`, `Copy`, `Check`, `ExternalLink`, `ShieldCheck`, `Cpu`).
- [x] **Cursor & Click States:** `cursor-pointer` explicitly applied on all interactive buttons, citation chips, and session rows.
- [x] **Micro-transitions:** 150ms–200ms ease-in-out transitions on hover, panel open/close, and modal transitions.
- [x] **WCAG Contrast:** All body text meets minimum 4.5:1 contrast against light and dark surfaces.
- [x] **Keyboard Navigation:** Full focus-visible rings (`ring-2 ring-indigo-500`), `Cmd+K` for new chat, `Esc` to close artifact viewer.
- [x] **Responsive Breakpoints:**
  - `Desktop (>= 1024px)`: 3-column split view (Sidebar + Chat + Artifact Viewer).
  - `Tablet (768px - 1023px)`: Collapsible sidebar, tab toggle between Chat and Artifact.
  - `Mobile (< 768px)`: Single-column chat with a bottom slide-up sheet for artifacts.
